content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. It’s lightweight, free to run, and ideal for creators launching 3 products or fewer. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) upgrades to Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, handling up to 100,000 requests per day on Cloudflare’s free tier and 500MB of PostgreSQL storage on Supabase. It’s built for scale and includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides documentation for all stacks but requires self-deployment. Each option removes platform dependency, but the Edge Commerce Stack is the only one designed for high-volume creators who need robust infrastructure without ongoing fees.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

All COREMERCH stacks bypass geographic restrictions by using no-KYC crypto payments via NOWPayments. This means creators in Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and Ethiopia can accept payments without a local bank account or PayPal. The Sovereign Starter Stack uses GitHub Pages, which is accessible globally, while the Edge Commerce Stack leverages Cloudflare’s edge network, ensuring low latency even in regions with poor internet infrastructure. Both stacks deliver product files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, neither of which restrict access based on location. The key difference is that the Edge Commerce Stack’s use of Cloudflare Workers and Supabase provides better performance and scalability for creators in high-restriction environments.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC, making it the most accessible option for creators in restricted regions. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10 each. The Sovereign Starter Stack integrates NOWPayments with GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, ensuring payments trigger product delivery instantly. The Edge Commerce Stack adds Supabase for order tracking and Cloudflare Workers for faster processing, but both stacks deliver the same payment speed. The real cost difference is in scalability: the Edge Commerce Stack’s use of Cloudflare and Supabase handles higher volumes without additional fees, while the Starter Stack is capped by Google Apps Script’s limitations.
Sovereign infrastructure means you own the stack—no platform can suspend your business.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With both stacks, you own the storefront code, customer list, order history, and product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment. The Sovereign Starter Stack automates delivery via Google Apps Script, while the Edge Commerce Stack uses Cloudflare Workers for more complex logic. File delivery is handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both of which you control. The Edge Commerce Stack’s use of Supabase for order storage provides better data ownership compared to Google Sheets, which has sharing limitations. If full infrastructure sovereignty is your goal, the Edge Commerce Stack delivers without compromise.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choose the Sovereign Starter Stack if you’re launching 3 products or fewer, need a no-code solution, and want to avoid all ongoing fees. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack if you’re scaling beyond 3 products, need to handle high traffic, or require robust email deliverability. The Sovereign Blueprint is for creators who prefer self-deployment but still want COREMERCH’s documentation. If you’re building multiple stores or need all templates, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes every blueprint and template, saving you $151 compared to purchasing separately.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure means owning the entire stack that powers your online store—from hosting to payment processing. This eliminates platform suspension risk, geographic restrictions, and data ownership issues. For digital creators, it’s the difference between renting a storefront and owning the building. COREMERCH’s stacks use free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, combined with no-KYC crypto payments via NOWPayments, to give you full control without recurring fees.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee and no-KYC policy remove geographic gatekeeping for crypto payments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re ready to deploy a sovereign stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It’s the fastest way to build, deploy, and scale a commerce infrastructure that works in any country. For creators looking to avoid payment platform suspensions or frozen funds, this kit provides everything you need to own your store, payments, and data—no workarounds, just base-layer infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack by first choosing between the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack based on your product volume and scalability needs. Purchase your chosen stack or the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Provide your product files, wallet addresses, and branding assets to COREMERCH for deployment. Test the stack end-to-end, ensuring payments trigger instant product delivery. Take full ownership of the deployed infrastructure—COREMERCH has no access after handover. Configure your domain’s DNS settings if using the Edge Commerce Stack. Start selling globally without platform restrictions.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can my PayPal account be frozen and my funds withheld?

Yes, PayPal can freeze accounts and withhold funds based on geographic location, business type, or transaction volume. Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes this risk by using no-KYC crypto payments via NOWPayments, ensuring you control your wallet and funds directly.
Why should digital creators own their store infrastructure instead of renting it?

Owning your infrastructure eliminates platform suspension risk, geographic restrictions, and recurring fees. It gives you full control over your storefront, customer data, and payment processing, ensuring your business can operate uninterrupted in any region.
What does no-KYC crypto payment mean for my store?

No-KYC crypto payments via NOWPayments allow you to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies without requiring buyer identification or account setup. This removes geographic gatekeeping, enabling creators in restricted countries to sell globally with low fees and instant settlement.
How does sovereign infrastructure handle product delivery?

Product delivery is automated via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, triggered the moment payment confirms on-chain. Files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both of which you control, ensuring instant delivery without third-party delays or restrictions.
What happens after COREMERCH deploys my stack?

After deployment, you own the entire infrastructure—COREMERCH has no access. You control the storefront code, customer list, order history, product files, and wallet addresses. Updates and scaling are handled by you, using the provided blueprints and documentation.
Cloudflare Workers and Supabase scale to 100,000 requests per day on free tiers.
